_comment: 泳道宽度：一个十一分支并行、并且最近三个提交落在 main 上的月，所以同一页里既有「只有一条泳道」的行，也有十条泳道的行。
两个平台各拍一张，图形宽度由同一份 grid 决定：fixture 是宿主在这一版代码上对真实仓库打印出来的网格，逐格抄的，不是手画的。
断言之一量的是「每行只占自己需要的那几条泳道」：最近三行只有一条泳道（21px/pt），合并行与分支行是十条（147），而且每一行的标题都紧跟着自己那条图形，所以标题左缘相差一百多——正是这里要的。
断言之二量的是封顶与折叠标记：第十条泳道的最右点 x=133，超过窗口的两条线画成菱形、仍落在这一列，这些行上也没有竖向笔画。

git-lane-window.note: 十一分支的月：最近三行只有一条泳道，标题紧跟在线上；合并行与它下面的分支行是十条泳道（147px）。超过窗口的两条线（stimuli、robustness）画成菱形落在第十列（x=133），与第十列自己的圆点区分开。

steps.eval: (() => { const sel = document.querySelector('#context-panel-view'); if (!sel) throw new Error('the context panel has no view selector'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(sel, 'review'); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return 'switched to ' + sel.value; })()

(() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent === '历史'); if (!tab) throw new Error('no History tab for a Git workspace'); tab.click(); return 'opened history'; })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-git-commit]')]; const pics = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-lane-graph]')]; if (rows.length !== 16) throw new Error('expected the eleven-branch demo history, saw ' + rows.length + ' rows'); if (pics.length !== rows.length) throw new Error('a row has no lane picture: ' + pics.length + ' of ' + rows.length); const widths = pics.map(s => Math.round(s.getBoundingClientRect().width)); if (widths.slice(0, 3).some(w => w !== 21)) throw new Error('a one-lane row is not two cells wide: ' + widths.slice(0, 3).join(',')); if (widths[3] !== 147) throw new Error('the merge row is not the ten-lane window (147px): ' + widths[3]); const box = i => ({ pic: pics[i].getBoundingClientRect(), text: rows[i].children[1].getBoundingClientRect() }); const gaps = rows.map((_, i) => Math.round(box(i).text.left - box(i).pic.right)); if (gaps.some(g => g < 0)) throw new Error('a subject starts left of its picture: ' + gaps.join(',')); if (Math.max(...gaps) > 10) throw new Error('a subject is not hugging its own picture: ' + gaps.join(',')); const left = i => Math.round(box(i).text.left); if (left(0) >= left(3) - 100) throw new Error('the one-lane row gained no space back: ' + left(0) + ' vs ' + left(3)); const xs = [...new Set(pics.flatMap(s => [...s.querySelectorAll('circle')]).map(c => Math.round(Number(c.getAttribute('cx')))))]; if (Math.max(...xs) !== 133) throw new Error('the rightmost dot is not on the tenth lane (x=133): ' + xs.join(',')); const text = document.body.textContent || ''; for (const glyph of ['│', '┊', '─', '└', '┘', '┐', '┤', '┴']) { if (text.includes(glyph)) throw new Error('a box-drawing glyph reached the DOM: ' + glyph); } const colours = new Set(pics.flatMap(s => [...s.querySelectorAll('line, path, circle')]).map(n => n.getAttribute('stroke') || n.getAttribute('fill')).filter(Boolean)); return rows.length + ' rows, gutters ' + [...new Set(widths)].join('/') + 'px, subjects at ' + left(0) + '/' + left(3) + ', dots on ' + xs.join('/') + ', ' + colours.size + ' colours'; })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-lane-graph]')]; const diamond = s => [...s.querySelectorAll('path')].some(p => p.getAttribute('fill') && p.getAttribute('fill') !== 'none'); const threadsAt = (s, x) => [...s.querySelectorAll('line')].filter(l => Math.round(Number(l.getAttribute('x1'))) === x && Math.round(Number(l.getAttribute('x2'))) === x); const folded = rows.filter(diamond); if (folded.length !== 2) throw new Error('expected two folded tips, saw ' + folded.length); for (const s of folded) { const xs = [...s.querySelectorAll('path')].filter(p => p.getAttribute('fill') && p.getAttribute('fill') !== 'none').map(p => Math.round(Number((p.getAttribute('d') || '').split(' ')[1]))); if (xs.length !== 1 || xs[0] !== 133) throw new Error('a fold mark is not on the tenth lane (x=133): ' + xs.join(',')); if (threadsAt(s, 133).length) throw new Error('a folded mark still carries a vertical thread, so the marks join up'); if (s.querySelectorAll('circle').length) throw new Error('a folded commit was also drawn as a disc'); } return 'two folded tips drawn as diamonds on x=133, unjoined'; })()

(() => { const pics = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-lane-graph]')]; const dash = pics.map(s => [...s.querySelectorAll('line')].filter(l => l.getAttribute('stroke-dasharray'))); for (let i = 0; i < dash.length; i++) { const want = i >= 7 && i <= 14; if (want && (dash[i].length !== 1 || Math.round(Number(dash[i][0].getAttribute('x1'))) !== 133)) throw new Error('row ' + i + ' should carry exactly one dashed bundle thread on x=133, saw ' + dash[i].length); if (!want && dash[i].length) throw new Error('row ' + i + ' drew a dashed thread where the column is a lane: ' + dash[i].length); } return 'eight bundle threads dashed on x=133, the rest solid'; })()

git-lane-window.note: 同一份历史在手机上：最近三行的标题紧跟在一条泳道后面（图形 21pt），合并行与分支行是十条泳道（147pt），标题因此还剩不少宽度；两条超出窗口的线画成菱形落在第十列。
